squid.why: singular head is 'Calmar'; plural of calmar is 'calmars' (spelling-variant mismatch: Calmar vs Calamars)

tanker-truck.why: both elements pluralize in this noun+noun compound

teacher.why: plural must match the singular head 'Professeur', not a different lexeme (enseignant)

woodpecker.why: plural must match the singular head 'Pic' (le pic); 'piverts' is a different lexeme

yak.why: singular head is 'Yak'; its plural is 'Yaks' ('Yacks' belongs to the variant spelling 'yack')

wrench.why: head noun 'clé à molette' is feminine (une clé)
